visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with long white hair in pigtails, prominent pointed elf ears, and dark sunglasses is seated inside the open door of a large olive-drab military helicopter. She wears white and gold robes and is holding a mounted machine gun with her right hand. The setting is an outdoor grassy field under bright natural daylight. (2) The scene cuts to a wider shot of the helicopter's open cargo bay. The same elf-like character is now kneeling, holding a rocket-propelled grenade (RPG) launcher. Beside her is a man in full military flight suit and helmet pointing forward. Two other female characters in stylized fantasy costumes (one with green hair and a black dress, another with purple hair and a purple outfit) are posing on either side of the open bay. (3) A close-up shot shows another female character with dark blue hair and a white headpiece, dressed in a navy and white uniform with sunglasses, saluting from a window of the helicopter. The camera then cuts back to the group in the cargo bay performing a synchronized rhythmic dance move. (4) The final phase shows the white-haired elf character standing outside on the grass in front of the helicopter. She is holding the RPG launcher on her shoulder with one hand and saluting with the other. A large modern glass building and a crowd of people are visible in the background background.
